candnew.bulk_d: Upload a ZIP of CV files or an Excel sheet exported from your existing system. Each row or file becomes a candidate waiting for review.
candnew.code_d2: Clients see this code on every share page, so use it when you talk about a person on the phone or in email. Change the prefix and numbering in Settings → Company.
candnew.code_t: Every candidate gets a code automatically
candnew.form_d: A guided 7-step form that follows the Japanese 履歴書 layout: basic info, family, education, work history, Japanese level, health, motivation, photo and videos.
candnew.form_t: Fill in the form step by step
candnew.form_time: About 10 minutes · progress is saved as a draft
candnew.sub: Choose how you want to bring the 履歴書 into Rireki. You can always edit every field afterwards.
candnew.upload_d: DOCX or PDF, in Vietnamese, Burmese, Bengali, Indonesian, English or Japanese. Rireki reads the file, fills the 履歴書 fields and asks you to confirm anything it is unsure about.

detail.docs_hint: Documents stay internal. They appear on a share page only when the link's "Documents" section is switched on, and download follows the link's download setting.
detail.note_ph: Add a note for your team…
detail.notes_hint: Notes are visible to your team only. They are never shown to clients.
detail.videos_hint: The first video is shown as the main video on share pages. Drag to reorder.

form.address_kana_hint: Country and city in katakana, as printed on the 履歴書.
form.chrono: Oldest first, as on a Japanese 履歴書
form.confirm: I confirm the information matches the candidate's documents.
form.documents_hint: Passport scan, certificates, health check. Shared with clients only when you enable "Documents" on a link.
form.drop_video: Drop video files here or click to browse
form.drop_video_hint: Tip: 1–3 minutes, speaking Japanese, filmed in landscape
form.edu_hint: Rendered on the 履歴書 as separate 入学 and 卒業 rows.
form.family: Family & spouse (家族構成・配偶者)
form.food: Foods that cannot be eaten (食べられないもの)
form.internal_tags: Internal tags (not printed on the 履歴書)
form.level_hint: Company assessment (当社評価): 10 = a conversation between native speakers. Printed on the 履歴書 as a 0–10 scale.
form.missing_d: Photo and email. You can still create the candidate and fill them later.
form.motivation_pr: Motivation for working in Japan & self-PR (日本での就職志望動機、自己PR)
form.name_romaji: Name (氏名, Latin as in passport)
form.religion_notes: Religious considerations (宗教的に注意が必要な事項)
form.title: Step-by-step form
form.videos_hint: MP4 / MOV up to 500 MB each. Videos are transcoded and streamed; clients can never download the original file when a link is view-only.
form.wishes: Other wishes (その他・本人希望)
form.work: Work history (職歴・アルバイト含む)
form.work_hint: Include part-time jobs. Rendered as 入社 / 退職 rows with the job description underneath.

import.kana_hint: Generated from the romanized name. Check the long vowels.
import.level_hint: Not in the document: your staff sets this company assessment.
import.preview_hint: Yellow boxes mark where a low-confidence value was read from. Click a field on the right to jump to its source.
import.result: 34 fields extracted · 4 need your review (marked in yellow). Fields we could not find are left empty.
import.sub: Rireki reads the uploaded document and fills the 履歴書 fields. Confirm the highlighted fields before saving.

landing.cta_note: Free during phase 1 · your own subdomain · set up in two minutes
landing.eyebrow: For sending organizations in Vietnam, Myanmar, Bangladesh and Indonesia
landing.f1_d: Upload the CV you already have. Rireki extracts names, katakana, education, work history and Japanese level, and shows you what to double-check.
landing.f2_d: A 7-step form in the staff member's language that outputs a correct Japanese 履歴書, including 家族構成, 健康状態 and 志望動機.
landing.f3_d: A candidate code, original and katakana names, one CV, several self-introduction videos and internal documents, all in one place.
landing.f4_d: Pick candidates, set a password, an expiry and whether download is allowed, and send one link. Single-candidate links work too.
landing.f5_d: Watermarked pages with the viewer's name, no files served, printing and copying blocked, content hidden when the window is inactive.
landing.f6_d: Views per candidate, per viewer and per day, video watch rate, and "Interested" marks sent back by the client.
landing.f_lead: Built around how sending organizations actually work: many staff, many candidates, many Japanese clients, and strict expectations about privacy.
landing.f_title: Everything between the trainee's CV and the client's decision
landing.h1: Manage every trainee's 履歴書 and send it to Japan with one protected link.
landing.how1_d: yourcompany.rireki.app with one or more admins and as many staff users as you need.
landing.how2_d: Import files or fill the form, add videos, tag by job type and Japanese level.
landing.how3_d: The client opens the link with a password, reviews candidates, marks interest. You see every view.
landing.how3_t: Send a link and follow up
landing.langs_d: Staff in Hà Nội, Yangon or Dhaka work in their own language; the client in Nagoya reads the same candidate in Japanese.
landing.langs_note: The 履歴書 itself is always produced in Japanese, with the original-language version kept alongside.
landing.lead: Import CVs from DOCX or PDF, keep one profile per person with videos and a candidate code, then share a password-protected, view-only link with your clients and see exactly who opened it.
landing.sec1: Password or open links, expiry dates, view limits and email-domain restrictions
landing.sec2: View-only or download-allowed, decided per link by the person who creates it
landing.sec3: Admin and User roles, full audit log
landing.sec4: Data hosted in Japan (Tokyo region), encrypted at rest and in transit
landing.sec_lead: Personal data of trainees is sensitive. Every link is scoped, expiring and traceable, and your team's access is controlled by roles.
landing.sec_title: Made for the trust between you and your Japanese clients

members.invite_hint: Invitees set their own password. Invitations expire after 7 days.
members.roles_d: Every workspace needs at least one admin.

perm.links_create: Create share links and see their tracking
perm.links_revoke: Revoke or edit any share link

settings.audit_d: Every sign-in, setting change, export, link creation and revocation. Kept for 24 months.
settings.branding_d: Shown on the pages your clients open
settings.capture_strict: Strict — watermark, blur on focus loss, block print/shortcuts
settings.code_next_hint: Increases by 1 for every new candidate; gaps are never reused.
settings.code_prefix_hint: A–Z only. Changing it affects new candidates only.
settings.code_rule: Codes are always 8 characters: 2 capital letters followed by 6 digits, e.g. AZ123456.
settings.def_contact: Show candidate contact info to clients
settings.def_identity: Ask viewers for name and email
settings.free_d: No plan to choose and no invoice. Every feature is available to every workspace.
settings.link_defaults_d: Applied to every new link. Members can change them per link unless locked.
settings.sub: Workspace of Sao Việt Manpower · saoviet.rireki.app
settings.subdomain_warn: Changing the subdomain changes every share link you have already sent. Old links keep working for 30 days and then stop.

sharenew.capture_note: Screen capture cannot be fully blocked by a web browser. View-only mode makes copying hard and makes every screenshot traceable through the watermark; the mobile app additionally blocks screenshots on Android and detects them on iOS.
sharenew.created_d: Send the link and the password through different channels. You can revoke or extend the link at any time from its tracking page.
sharenew.download_d: The client can download the 履歴書 as PDF and the video and document files. Every download is logged with the viewer's identity.
sharenew.identity_d: Required for per-person tracking and for the watermark. Without it, views are logged as anonymous with IP and device only.
sharenew.identity_t: Ask viewers for name and email
sharenew.include_pw: Include the password in this email (not recommended)
sharenew.max_views_hint: Counted per opening of the link, not per candidate.
sharenew.order_hint: Drag to set the order the client sees. Selecting exactly one candidate creates a single-candidate link that opens straight on their 履歴書.
sharenew.pw_d: Anyone with the link must enter this password. Send it through a different channel than the link (phone, LINE, separate email).
sharenew.qr_d: Useful when meeting the client in person or for printed proposals. The password is still required.
sharenew.sec_contact_hint: — hidden by default so clients contact you, not the candidate
sharenew.sec_interested: Let the client mark "Interested" and leave a comment
sharenew.sec_notify: Email me on first view and on "Interested"
sharenew.sub: Pick candidates from your database, choose how the client may view them, then send the link.
sharenew.subject: Subject
sharenew.viewonly_d: No PDF or video file is ever sent to the browser. Pages render as protected images with a watermark showing the viewer's name, email and time. Right-click, print, save and text selection are disabled, and the page blurs when the window loses focus.

shares.danger_d: The client will see "This link is no longer available". Tracking data is kept.
shares.title: Share links

viewer.expired_t: This link is no longer available
viewer.feedback_hint: Only the sender sees this. Candidates are never notified.
viewer.hidden_d: The page is blurred while this window is not active. Click to continue viewing.
viewer.invited: You have been invited to view
viewer.password_hint: (sent to you separately by the sender)
viewer.protection_note: This page is view-only: no file is downloaded to your device, printing and copying are disabled, and the page hides its content when the window is inactive.
viewer.rendered: Rendered as protected image · watermark applied
viewer.terms: By continuing you agree to use this information only for recruitment purposes and not to share it with third parties.
viewer.video_hint: Streamed with a per-viewer watermark. Downloading is disabled for this link.
viewer.viewonly_d: Documents and videos can be viewed but not downloaded, printed or copied. Your name, email and viewing time are shown as a watermark and recorded for the sender.
